features.name: semicolon_comment_share
features.definition: What proportion of the counter-argument comments contain at least one semicolon?
features.spec: Parse OC_comments with json.loads into a list of strings. If parsing fails or the value is missing, return null. If the list is empty, return null. Otherwise return (number of comments containing the ';' character) / (number of comments). Raw literal matching on current text; no semantic filtering, and quoted text or URLs/HTML entities containing ';' are counted too.

h0: semicolon_comment_share has no association with delta (the probability that the OP changed their view).
h1: Higher semicolon_comment_share is associated with a lower probability of delta.
note: Persuasiveness is operationalized as the dataset outcome delta (OP changed view). Semicolon presence is only a literal proxy for 'overly complex compound sentences'. Complexity itself is not measured. The share is used as the row-level scalar because comments are pooled per row. A semicolon-containing comment is counted even if the semicolon is in a quotation or entity such as &. Comment order and timing are unknown. Text may contain outcome announcements, and raw text is not outcome-free. The test is an association, not causal.
